brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE polished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 16:9, preferably 1792x1024 or 1920x1080, width over 1000 pixels. Fully opaque.

Match the approved visual style previously viewed: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush slashes, warm ivory Japanese typography, energetic hand-drawn black ink hatching and screenprint texture. Minimal, bold, highly readable. The reference thumbnail is STYLE ONLY: do not copy its person, names, statistics, scores, or date.

Subject: exactly one REAL player, Yudai Nishida (西田優大), selected randomly from the fixed article's named players. Render an original ink-and-brush illustration of Nishida making a low, forward-driving basketball move, three-quarter frontal view, eyes focused ahead, one hand controlling an orange basketball low beside his waist and the other arm naturally bent for balance. Keep face, both hands and entire basketball visible, anatomically believable fingers and joints. It is a general imagined basketball movement, not a recreation of an actual game, scoring moment, appearance or result. No other players or human silhouettes.

Appearance based on the official SeaHorses Mikawa 2026-27 profile photo inspected in this conversation (https://go-seahorses.jp/team/players/detail/id=17209?PlayerID=30403; image https://go-seahorses.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1789089098/files/user/team/player/2026-27/19_blue.jpg): Japanese man with a lean athletic upper body and long neck, elongated oval face, straight medium-length dark hair with light ash-brown highlights, off-center part and front locks framing the forehead, straight brows, narrow almond-shaped eyes, straight nose, slightly full lips, small beauty mark near cheek/upper lip area, clean shaven with no beard or moustache. Preserve these recognizable facial features. Do not reuse the earlier reference's Black player or invent a generic player. Ink-rendered face must remain clearly readable, not lost in black shadow. Jersey and shorts plain dark blue and ivory, completely unbranded, without letters, logos, sponsor marks, or jersey numbers. No photographic pixels and no photorealism.

Composition: player on RIGHT 43% of canvas, leaning forward diagonally into the image with strong motion; visible from head to around knees. Typography on LEFT 57%, safely separated from hands and ball. A restrained broad diagonal lime brush stroke behind player only; keep text background quiet. Leave generous safe margins at all edges. The visual emphasis is the editorial selection, not the depicted individual's performance.

Render ONLY the following exact Japanese text, each item cleanly legible:
Top small: "11/17　試合前"
Main heading white, large: "登録選手の"
Main heading below, largest and lime: "ベスト5"
Subheading white, medium: "今季平均EFFで選出"
Below subheading white, smaller but clearly readable: "出場確定ではありません"
Bottom left footnote, high contrast and readable: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Next to footnote: "イメージ"

Text is based only on fixed source.html and source.txt for 2026-11-17: a pregame selection from registered players using season-average EFF, not match-day results or confirmed starters. Show no player name, individual performance, score, personal statistic, guaranteed participation, ranking comparison between leagues, or team/league branding. Do not add other text, fake logos, date fragments, captions, watermarks, or decoration that looks like writing. Do not copy the official photo into the artwork.

qa_notes.likeness_or_no_named_person: 西田優大の公式プロフィール写真と見比べ、分けた前髪と明るいハイライト、面長の輪郭、細めの目、口元の特徴、ひげなしを確認。実在選手1名のイラストで、名前や活躍の断定は画像内にない。
qa_notes.layout: 黒×ライムのインク・ブラシ表現。文字と顔は判読可能。両手とボール全体が見え、指・関節に目立つ破綻なし。顔・ボール・文字の欠けなし。ユニフォームにロゴ・スポンサー・番号なし。下半身と右肘の端は動きを示す意図的なトリミング。
